verdict.rationale: LiteLLM's proxy ships an admin UI alongside a documented programmatic surface: an auto-generated OpenAPI spec and Swagger UI on every deployment, and API-driven management of virtual keys, teams, users and budgets. That makes much of the UI's work scriptable, but nothing documents that every UI action has an API equivalent, and some flows are shown only through the UI (e.g., adding MCP servers). Missing for 10: an explicit UI–API parity statement, API documentation for UI-only flows such as MCP server registration, independent or hands-on corroboration of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
